summary: The native parser also works on Linux hosts; the example parses ip addr show output with a template stored as templates/fedora_ip_addr_show.yaml.
questions: Can cli_parse parse Linux command output?
What template name does cli_parse expect on Fedora?

answer_card.title: Native parser on Linux
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. For `ip addr show` on Fedora, save the template as `templates/fedora_ip_addr_show.yaml` (OS from `ansible_distribution`, command with underscores).
